programs.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programs.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.

programs.title: Blue Planet Revisited
programs.desc: A team of scientists and researchers of the aquatic environment is looking at changes taking place in the underwater world.They want to show viewers the state of ocean waters on the eastern coast of America, the Bahamas and the Great Barrier Reef of Australia and show the life of, among others,whales and their young and turtle hatchlings.The program is a compilation of the most interesting fragments of footage recorded during the "Blue Planet Live" project in March 2019, which consisted of week-long broadcasts of large-scale undersea research.

programs.title: Dynasties II
programs.desc:
The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquettes, the females of which are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty.
Against the backdrop of pristine corners of the Earth - from harsh Patagonia to African savannahs - various animal families fight for survival.Parents must pass on to their offspring skills that will influence their lives.Produced on an impressive scale, the series presents the adventures of animal clans, devoting each episode to different characters.Representatives of the fauna kingdom are shown through the prism of human behavior - they fight fiercely for power, build alliances, look for partners and provide their children with a school of life.And all this takes place against the background of phenomenal landscapes from the farthest corners of the globe.In the land of meerkats This time, the filmmakers go to Botswana, where a multi-generational herd of meerkats lives in the hot and dry climate of the Makgadikgadi salt flats.The ruler, who was named Maghogho, must unite her family so that her young can survive in an extremely hostile environment.However, she lacks experience, so she works by trial and error.In moments of danger, she sometimes makes bad decisions.Fate puts many challenges before her - from problems with a gang of rivals to violent storms.There are plenty of suspenseful moments in this bittersweet story.However, the herd of little ones has a chance to survive thanks to the strong bond that unites them.
